translation: The Great Discourse on Yin and Yang says: The spring qi is warm and mild, the summer qi is hot and sultry, the autumn qi is clear and cool, and the winter qi is biting and cold. This is the order of the upright qi of the four seasons. In winter the cold is severe, and the ten thousand things hide deeply; if the gentleman is careful and thorough, then he is not injured by cold. Only those who encounter and brave it are called cold damage (shanghan). Being injured by the qi of the four seasons can all cause disease.
